reading.body:
Five projects make up this collection with a combined 183,883 GitHub stars, led by Microsoft's autogen at 60,741 and crewAI at 57,963, which together account for nearly two thirds of the category's total stars.

autogen also appears in this site's ai-frameworks collection with the identical 60,741 star count, meaning the same repository is tracked in both a general AI framework category and this multi-agent-specific one, evidence that orchestration frameworks and general-purpose AI frameworks overlap enough that a single project can legitimately belong to both. The A2A protocol repository, at 25,586 stars, is described as an open protocol for communication between opaque agentic applications rather than a framework itself, a different kind of project from the other four repositories in this collection.

Licensing splits three ways, 2 of 5 under MIT, 2 of 5 under Apache-2.0, and 1 under CC-BY-4.0, the same three-licence split pattern seen in the ai-frameworks collection elsewhere in this site, though with a different repository composition.
